messages:
Ashley: Hey team — want to lock in a 30m preflight sync for DeltaCorp private deployment. Need to run through network/NAT, IAM/KMS, canaries, test harness, and rollback plan. Proposed slots: Tue 10:00-10:30 PT or Wed 14:00-14:30 PT. Who's available? Link to runbook: https://redwood.app/runbooks/deltacorp-preflight

Omar: Tue works for me. I'll bring the VPC peering notes.

Matt: Wed is better for SRE; Tue I'm in a customer call. If we do Wed, can we push to 14:30? otherwise 14:00 ok.

Sophie: I can do both, will prepare KMS/TLS checklist.

Liz: I'll join for rollback/runbook. Also please add 'migration of service account tokens' as a line item.

Ashley: Ok Wed 14:30 PT then. Agenda (rough):
1) network connectivity checks (Omar)
2) KMS + secrets (Sophie)
3) canary routing + traffic shaping (Matt)
4) rollback + runbook handoff (Liz)
5) test harness + smoke tests (QA)
6) open Qs. Anything missing? :thinking_face:

Matt: Add 'observability smoke - synthetic trace + latency alert thresholds'

Omar: Also confirm firewall egress to S3 endpoints (DeltaCorp uses cross-account buckets) — pointing to config: ```tf
resource "aws_vpc_endpoint" "s3" {
  # ensure policy allows cross-account GetObject
}
```

deploy-bot: Preflight report for deltacorp-env-1: network checks PASS, k8s nodes ready=5, kv-cache capacity 80%, last successful smoke test 2026-03-10T08:02Z. See /deploy/reports/1780012330

Ashley: Thanks. I'll create calendar invite for Wed 2026-03-18 14:30 PT and add agenda + pre-reads. If you can't make it, drop notes here or DM and we'll record. :calendar: 

Liz: Pinged CS to confirm a DeltaCorp engineer will join for the DB cutover discussion.

Sophie: I'll attach KMS key policy diff to the invite.

Matt: I'll add the canary traffic gradation plan as a short doc link in the invite.

Ashley: Great, final attendee list: Ashley, Omar, Matt, Sophie, Liz, QA (TBD), CS (Marta), DeltaCorp Eng (TBD). See you Wed. :thumbsup:
